cheapBound.question: how many candidate stations does the determined ladder carry on the face, at C-0148's own phase 16 and C-0141's forced 14 bp inter-row offset?
cheapBound.answer: the ten rooting helices carry 5, 6, 5, 6, 5, 6, 5, 6, 5, 6 stations, in total
cheapBound.consequence: the 5 bp rows are the 102 bp sense and the 6 bp rows the 109 bp one, so the 7 bp row stagger shows up as a STATION and the family is not uniform

cheapBound.question: how large is the placement family at the deciding five-column cell?
cheapBound.answer: the five-station rows are forced (C(5,5) = 1) and each six-station row has C(6,5) = 6 choices, so the family is 6^5 and it is EXHAUSTIBLE
cheapBound.consequence: C-0102's *a descent compared against an exhaustive enumeration is not a comparison* and CH-0119's *a placement-searched family measures the search* are both removed at the cell C-0208's and C-0212's tightest readings live at

cheapBound.question: does the family admit a CENTRO-SYMMETRIC member, as C-0063's square-lattice winner was?
cheapBound.answer: no -- row r maps to row 9 - r under (s, y) -> (-s, -y), those rows carry OPPOSITE window parities, and the intersection is empty at every one of the 5 row pairs
cheapBound.units: row pairs admitting any centro-symmetric station pair
cheapBound.consequence: C-0063's entire search strategy was a centro-symmetry congruence and it has NO analogue here: the honeycomb's forced row stagger destroys the symmetry the square lattice's answer was built on, which is exactly why the family being exhaustible matters

cheapBound.question: how wide is the placement axis the corpus has never swept, on the screening stream at the deciding cell?
cheapBound.answer: the exhaustive census over 7776 placements at equal springs runs 0.0890058 to 0.129966804
cheapBound.consequence: a placement is a DESIGN and not a lottery exactly to the extent this spread exceeds the distribution axis C-0212 measured at 1.10434917 to 1.70065256

findings: THE PLACEMENT AND THE DISTRIBUTION HAVE NOW BEEN SEARCHED TOGETHER, and the answer is a TOTAL of -0.4526 log units with an INTERACTION of -12.96 %. The interaction is NEGATIVE, so the two freedoms are SYNERGISTIC: each is worth MORE when the other is free.

THE SPLIT IS ORDER-DEPENDENT AND BOTH ORDERINGS ARE EMITTED. Placement first: -0.009241 then -0.4434. Distribution first: -0.3046 then -0.1481. The two totals agree identically and their difference IS the interaction -- the path disagreement is below 1.0E-12 of a log unit.

AND THE SAME 2 x 2 IS TAKEN IN SAMPLE, WHICH IS WHAT SEPARATES THE INTERACTION FROM THE SELECTION. Out of sample every corner but (P0, D0) carries a selection and the placement freedom carries a much larger one; in sample none of them does. The interaction is -12.96 % out of sample and -7.845 % in sample, and the joint corner does beat both singles in sample against does out of it.
C-0063's ORDERING, MEASURED ON THIS LATTICE: REVERSED. The placement main effect is 0.009241 and the distribution main effect 0.3046 in log units.

THE CHEAP BOUND DECIDED THE METHOD AND IT NEEDED NO SOLVE: the determined ladder carries 55 stations, 5, 6, 5, 6, 5, 6, 5, 6, 5, 6 by row, so at five columns the five-station rows are FORCED and the family is 6^5 = 7776 -- exhaustible. And it admits NO centro-symmetric member at any of its 5 row pairs, so C-0063's own search strategy has no analogue here.

THE INHERITED SENTENCE, MEASURED: equal springs ranks the placements at Spearman -0.08242 against the searched objective, with a regret of 1.10542; rim-graded 5:1 ranks the placements at Spearman 0.489 against the searched objective, with a regret of 1.04061; equal springs ranks the placements at Spearman -0.438 against the searched objective, with a regret of 1.19325; rim-graded 5:1 ranks the placements at Spearman 0.6264 against the searched objective, with a regret of 1.0. CLAUDE.md's *selecting a placement on the EQUAL-SPRING objective is selecting on the wrong quantity once a distribution is free* is a warning this corpus asserts and had never measured on this lattice.

EVERY THRESHOLD THE MOVING QUANTITIES FEED, AND THEIR CONJUNCTION -- which CH-0272 records no verdict block here has ever stated: over 17 graded corners, 7 are flat at the 90th percentile, 1 are flat AND inside C-0023's per-path allowable, and 0 beat the uncoupled tile.
validity: TRL 1-3. Model-consistent and traceable. NOT empirically demonstrated. No such coupling has been drawn, let alone folded.

The PLACEMENT family is C-0141's determined station ladder on the rooting helices, at the phase C-0148's +/-5 bp rule DETERMINES (16) and the forced 14 bp inter-row offset. The three unrealisable members of C-0167's four placements are GRADED and not SEARCHED.

The radial link constant is unsourceable (C-0208) and is carried at its bracket FLOOR alone here; C-0212 measured the rung axis with the placement fixed and its flat verdict moved at none of the five.
CH-0242's common-mode spring is absent, so every bond and every tie is still missing the stiffer of the two springs.
The census is on ROUTE A, whose raster turns carry ZERO unpaired nucleotides (C-0175's modelling choice). C-0193 and C-0200 establish that the only folded block of this cross-section does otherwise.

C-0060's 3.5 to 20.0 is its FLAT ratio window, measured on C-0058's square-lattice 45-station design, and it is NOT a buildability constraint (CH-0273). It is read here on the TWO-LEVEL projection, which is the object C-0060 measured it on.
BUILDABILITY is not established at any corner. What it costs to PLACE a distribution spanning a large stiffness ratio is C-0060's own placement question, and nothing in this corpus prices it.

A DESCENT REPORTS THE BEST POINT IT FOUND. The five-column cell is exhaustive; 10, 20 and 30 paths are a per-row descent whose slack is measured at the five-column cell (F21) and is not zero by assumption.
The COUNT is out of sample and WHICH placement is tightest is an order statistic over 7776 of them. Quote the count as the result and the placement as an identification.
One load case (C-0022's solved collar at 2 mM, 10 nm, 0.192 V), one cross-section, one raster, one dropout model, one composite fraction unless P8 ran.
openQuestions: The LADDER PHASE is determined by C-0148's rule on the drawable raster and is therefore not a design variable here. Whether a raster that closes at another phase would place better is a question about the RASTER, not the placement.

A smoothed CVaR of a log-sum-exp -- convex in the sampled field, an upper bound on the percentile, differentiable throughout -- would let the DISTRIBUTION half use an adjoint gradient on the quantity the verdict is read on. C-0212 priced it and this task inherits the pricing unchanged.
The best design inside C-0060's TWO-LEVEL family, searched rather than projected into; CLAUDE.md prices the projected-against-searched gap at 24.9 %.

Whether the SHARED-BODY topology -- C-0017's mandate spent once in a rigid-body mode rather than at every station -- moves this census. That is a change of TOPOLOGY, and it is orthogonal to both factors measured here.
What a joint search does on ROUTE B, whose turns carry 28 unpaired nucleotides.
What it costs to PLACE the joint optimum: its stiffness ratio is 65.2239927, and C-0060's own exponents turn that into a member LENGTH nobody has priced on this lattice.
